title: French musicians on the European tour
summary: Lee and Mary recall the saxophonist Guy Lafitte and pianist Claude Bolling.

story.theme_name: Going abroad: American jazz musicians touring and living in Europe
story.community_name: Going abroad: touring Europe and Japan

blocks.x: Well, we played with French men. Was a good saxophone player, good piano saxophone, put me on the Covenhock. What was that boy's name, Mary?
Gilly Feet. Gilly Feet. And the piano player? The piano player was... What piano player? The piano player was a boy named, what's his name again? Claude Bowling.

Oh, yes. He has a band of his own sometimes. He played just like oil hives in oil good days. Really? The sound is like oil. That was my jazz piano player, oil hives. When I say oil hives, I'm caught in a whole lot of territory. So...
